facts.fact: Diego 的与众不同：蠢到爱上了她——她眼里最易武器化的卫兵。
facts.anchor: Diego was stupid enough to be in love with me.

facts.fact: 她的冷评：男人们从没想过城堡的大火正是「落难少女」自己放的。
facts.anchor: the damsel might be the one setting fire to the castle

facts.fact: 她对 Diego 说出全场唯一一句真话：暴力救不了她，情报才行。
facts.anchor: "Violence won't free me." I ghosted my fingertips over his sleeve. "Information will."

facts.fact: 父亲死时在 Ironwood pack 留有忠于他的旧部——她让 Diego 给他们中的一个人递消息。
facts.anchor: My father still had loyalists in the Ironwood pack when he died.

facts.fact: Gunnar 的气息抵达：浸血铜味裹着灼热薄荷——她隔着墨镜也认得出。
facts.anchor: Copper. Heavy, metallic, blood-soaked copper, wrapped in the sharp, burning heat of peppermint.

facts.fact: Diego 口误称 Ms. Lobo，Gunnar 当场纠正为 Mrs. Blackwood。
她的算盘：让他以为占有她、随他圈地——项圈最终会套在他脖子上。
facts.anchor: Let him think he owns me. Let the brute mark his territory. It only makes it easier for me to put the collar around his neck.

facts.fact: 反转收尾：把新婚两口子支回庄园也在 Sorsha 计划之内——而她母亲总以为场上只有自己一个下棋的。
facts.anchor: Everything was going according to Sorsha Lobo's plan.
